execution: GPU LaTeX glyph drawing (original WebGPU draw.wgsl or shared WebGL2 adapter), JavaScript LaTeX layout, native symbolic WASM, compiled Morphing fields, existing VKF browser rigid-body physics reference
scope: Gaussian-integer game round; not the complete calculus/multiplayer concept
compatibility: Operation + expression applies when both result components are exact integers. Principal root: sqrt(-1)=+i. Expression + expression bounces. Operations compose only into one supported simple operation or cancellation.
indexing: object-ID map and spatial grid for targets; cached native glyph layouts and indexed GPU instances
exactness: Native symbolic evaluation of real components, independently guarded by exact BigInt Gaussian arithmetic and integer-square-root witnesses. Both result components must be safe integers.
contacts: Indexed compatibility detection routes valid contacts into morphology. VKF resolves rejected contacts and whole-world constraints; held objects are authored as kinematic bodies. Impossible grab targets yield to VKF zero-time projection of finite masses; they cannot force overlaps against walls.
viewport: fixed visual-viewport shell, no document scrolling or surface touch panning
morphology: native Morphing field.union and segment.value; immutable native LaTeX glyph packets resident on GPU; geometric operation absorption and expression-to-result stroke deformation
motion: Timed 32-sample pointer ring; recent 100 ms release velocity including hold-to-stop; throws capped at 1600 CSS pixels/second; no free damping; adaptive contact substeps; elastic area-weighted bounces; area-weighted merge velocity; explicit throws work in reduced motion.
physics: The unchanged packaged VKF stepRigidPolygonWorld2D runtime owns motion, wall constraints, exact-circle contacts and impulses. physics.mjs only maps game objects. This is its JavaScript browser reference, not compiled native/WASM/GPU physics.
